name: A live clock changes a story's expected text
query: This story's snapshot text changes across runs. Propose a focused stabilization and verification. I have a direct customer-facing Chromatic MCP connection but no Chromatic plugin installed.
context: A RelativeTime component correctly displays elapsed time in production. It accepts timestamp and now props, with now defaulting to the live clock. The story passes a fixed timestamp and now={Date.now}. Two locally observed runs at different times show different elapsed-time labels with otherwise identical inputs. There is no browser-specific evidence. The component already has unit tests for time boundaries. A direct MCP server is connected and exposes schema discovery and build/test queries; no hosted image pixels or remote capture provenance have been inspected. The user requests a proposal only.
expected_behavior: Identifies the changing story clock as the supported input-level cause and proposes supplying a fixed now value or function matching the existing prop contract
Preserves production live-clock behavior and the existing time-boundary tests
Proposes repeated focused local verification and a meaningful expected-label assertion without claiming a remote capture was verified
Uses the direct MCP capabilities if remote evidence is needed without requiring plugin installation
success_criteria: Does not require a particular browser or impose a second-browser test without evidence
Does not introduce an iframe fixture, arbitrary capture delay, weaker threshold, or global production clock change
Treats plugin packaging separately from MCP capabilities and does not claim an unqueried result
